name: Secrets Viewer
description: Browse the categorized secrets store (/app/data/secrets.json) as a themed, collapsible-by-product table - product, key, and when it was last set. Also lists every expected secret that doesn't have a value yet - curated ones from conf/secrets_defaults.json (Pushover, Prowl, Paperless-ngx, Gitea, several finance data providers) plus any a script registered itself by asking for a secret that wasn't there - clearly marked as placeholders, not stored values, with a banner if secrets.json doesn't exist at all yet - so a missing secret is visible and ready to fill in via Secrets Manager. Values are never shown, not even partially - only a character-count hint. Use Secrets Manager to add, update, or delete an entry.
